purpose: stair slope heave force and tip margin for 60kg plus tare
code_or_query:
import math
m_load=60.0
m_tare=7.38
m=m_load+m_tare
g=9.81
riser=0.197
going=0.254
theta=math.atan(riser/going)
F=m*g*math.sin(theta)
F_load_only=m_load*g*math.sin(theta)
print(f"theta_deg={math.degrees(theta):.1f} F_total={F:.0f}N F_load={F_load_only:.0f}N")
# tip-over: contacts spaced by orbit diameter projection; CG height ~0.6m, base ~0.28m
# margin estimate
lean=25.0
tip=37.0
print(f"lean {lean} tip {tip} margin {tip-lean}")
# brake torque check
T=m*g*0.14
print(f"T={T:.1f}Nm")
# energy per step
E=m*g*riser
print(f"E={E:.0f}J")
